cand.title: SIO 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting
cand.excerpt: Strong organized hospitality-demand mechanism and confirmed Toronto date; venue commitment reduces current-edition accessibility.
cand.selectionWhy: Ledger shows competitor venue/hotel: Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Lindsay McSwain is explicitly the 2027 SIO Event Lead and named accommodation sub-block contact; the staff directory titles her Events Coordinator. Caitlin Schmierer is Events Director and a relevant escalation for event logistics and future sourcing. Jena Eberly Stack is Executive Director and a strategic account-development contact. These are verified commercially relevant organizers, not proven individual hotel-contract signatories.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced activity dates: 24–28 February 2027, Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel, 123 Queen St W, Toronto, Ontario M5H 2M9, Canada. Within the requested horizon and upcoming as of 15 November 2026. Dates are stated on the meeting page, not inferred from publication dates. No official 2028 dates/city were located; do not project them.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment using the supplied hotel specifications: a 157-room Harbourfront city hotel with a roughly 240-theatre largest room cannot be positioned as exclusive housing or the plenary replacement for a meeting whose prospectus profiles 900+ participants. A small organizer-approved delegate/speaker/company lodging group, VIP lodging or side meeting is a plausible role, not demonstrated demand. The supplied 15–109-peak-room range is a sales-screening envelope only, not an event forecast. This is a downtown medical congress, not a demonstrated resort requirement. Sheraton is the actual meeting locus; MTCC walkability does not establish a demand link for this event. Do not promise catering or receptions until Radisson restaurant/lounge and event-service capability are verified.
findings.venueCommitments: Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel is the confirmed 2027 meeting venue AND the only publicly named official accommodation-block hotel located in this research. It is in downtown Toronto proper, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. Edition-specific housing terms publish CAD 359 per night plus taxes/fees, with cutoff 26 January 2027 or sellout, whichever first. No booking code was published in the retrieved page. No edition-specific commitment to the other example competing hotels was located. This is confirmed competing-hotel business, not merely a preferred list.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented sequence: Washington, DC (19–23 January 2023); Long Beach, California (25–29 January 2024; Long Beach Convention Center, Hyatt Regency Long Beach accommodation block); Las Vegas, Nevada (30 January–3 February 2025; Paris Las Vegas Hotel & Casino); Savannah, Georgia (4–8 February 2026; Savannah Convention Center); Toronto (24–28 February 2027; Sheraton Centre). This establishes changing destinations and annual series recurrence, not an annual Toronto recurrence or a published rotation policy. The 2026 event microsite shows 4–9 February, but the official exhibitor newsletter and conference recordings agree on 4–8 February. No earlier Toronto edition or announced Toronto return was verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Official host-hotel block, not an open RFP: “SIO has reserved a block of discounted rooms for the SIO 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting at the Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel.” Every hotel named on the 2027 housing page: Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel only. “Exhibiting and sponsoring companies looking to book 10 or more rooms should request a sub-block form”; approval depends on block availability; contact Lindsay McSwain, SIO Event Lead, lmcswain@sio-central.org, by 7 January 2027. That threshold is not published room demand. The page still says booking “will open this fall when registration launches”; live booking availability is not established by this wording. No separate housing bureau or open overflow sourcing process was identified. SIO warns that unsolicited housing companies are unaffiliated.
findings.organizationStructure: SIO is a nonprofit membership society and event owner, not a hotel, corporate end-client or DMC. Its official history says the former WCIO conference became its Annual Scientific Meeting and “continues annually.” The 2027 exhibitor contract states SIO orchestrates event management as “SIO Event Management.” Smithbucklin hosts the contracts and advertises an association-management role supporting SIO; this supports an association-management relationship, not ownership of SIO or proof of a separate hotel-contracting mandate. No separate Toronto PCO, DMC or housing bureau was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Sheraton has both meeting venue and discounted housing commitment, plus the housing page markets its PATH access during winter. The 2027 exhibitor contract also makes Sheraton the exclusive in-house food/beverage provider at the event facility. Section 24 reserves SIO control over suites/meeting rooms in the facility and block hotels; non-SIO-approved attendee-directed events within 50 miles of Sheraton during meeting dates are prohibited. No sourced sellout, overflow requirement, block exhaustion or Radisson allocation was found. Do not pitch an unauthorized competing function or represent independent lodging as official housing.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Lindsay McSwain first, copying Caitlin Schmierer: acknowledge the Sheraton commitment and ask whether SIO authorizes any additional hotel for unmet delegate/speaker/company lodging; request rooms-by-night needs and the 2027 Meeting/Function Space Application/approval route. Reference the 7 January 2027 company sub-block deadline and 26 January hotel cutoff, without treating them as an open hotel RFP. Offer only a capacity-appropriate lodging proposal subject to hotel availability and SIO approval. Ask Caitlin about future Toronto destination cycles and sourcing responsibility; escalate strategic relationship development to Jena Eberly Stack if appropriate. Verify Radisson catering/service operations before offering a hosted reception.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the researched upcoming 2027 edition: core host-hotel/meeting business is already committed elsewhere; no evidence of an open hotel search. Conditional overflow lodging or an approved ancillary function is realistic in product terms but unverified commercially. The actual 2027 contract requires a Meeting/Function Space Application, forbids meetings/private functions during Event Hours and product demonstrations in meeting rooms, and limits assigned suites/meeting rooms to exhibitors and allied organizations. Obtain permission before pursuing an attendee-directed side event at Radisson.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Annual series recurrence and changing destinations justify relationship development, not a claim of recurring Toronto demand. No official 2028 edition or next Toronto return was located. For any future Toronto cycle, position Radisson for a secondary block or approved small-group/ancillary role; a whole-congress replacement bid is not supported by the supplied capacity. Ask who controls destination selection, accommodation contracting and secondary-block placement, and when the next relevant sourcing window opens.
